purpose: Verify documentation against saved reference formats; no scores regenerated.

comparison_scopes.reference: Conservative maximum probability-error bound over the saved top-64 and serving top-50 union.
comparison_scopes.cache_and_batch: Conservative maximum probability-error bound over two serving top-50 lists.
comparison_scopes.decode: Exact absolute probability difference for the emitted token only; raw absolute log-probability error is recorded but not bounded by the acceptance policy.
